artworks.title: Orestes and Pylades before Thoas and Iphigenia
artworks.description: Pompeii fresco (VI.15.1): King Thoas presides as Orestes and Pylades stand before Iphigenia the priestess — Euripides' Taurian court in Roman domestic paint.

artworks.title: Orestes and Pylades before Iphigenia
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum plaque from an Iphigenia series: the recognition scene under Taurian law — Thoas' kingdom as the stage Euripides, Goethe and Gluck never left.

music.title: Iphigénie en Tauride
music.description: Gluck's Paris opera — Thoas as the Taurian king who demands Greek blood for Artemis, until recognition undoes the sacrifice.

popCulture.title: Iphigenia in Tauris
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' play — Thoas rules the Taurians and nearly sacrifices Orestes before Iphigenia steals the goddess and flees.

popCulture.title: Iphigenie auf Tauris
popCulture.creator: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
popCulture.description: Goethe's verse drama — Thoas humanized as a king who loves Iphigenia, still the Taurian obstacle to Greek return.

popCulture.title: Thoas (king of the Taurians)
popCulture.description: King of the Taurians who demanded strangers sacrificed to Artemis — Euripides' foil for Iphigenia's recognition plot.
